title: Acoustic Indoor Localization Augmentation by Self-Calibration and Machine Learning.
summary: Full paper reports experimental ML-based localization in a real cafeteria; evidence is limited to its marked zones and one setup.
ai_technology: Random-forest and neural classifiers learn TDoA-signature zones; physical experiments use marked table zones and labeled timestamps.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Real cafeteria experiments show learned zone localization; results section reports 91% and 88% association, while conclusion gives a differing 94% summary.
evidence.unknown: Test placements near trained points provide an in-situ evaluation; transfer to other venues is not established.
evidence.ai_role: Random-forest and neural classifiers learn TDoA-signature zones; physical experiments use marked table zones and labeled timestamps.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
